name: Confounding Flash
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: You've caught the attention of our superiors, adventurer. They've asked you travel to the Hall of Mysteries in Ironforge as soon as possible. Apparently they feel you've proven yourself already and are prepared to further your training. When you get there, find High Priestess Mims. She will be able to guide you further. Good luck, and may the Light be with you.
narrative.objectives: Speak to High Priestess Mims in Ironforge.
narrative.offerRewardText: You took your time arriving, Vall. But you can be excused given your dedicated service to the Light. Please pay close attention to this lesson.
